## Risk classification and review

- **Risk tier: Normal / Elevated / Critical**
- Rationale based on actual diff, data/privacy/permission/architecture impact:
- Independent reviewer and review evidence:
- Required additional negative/integration/system/security evidence:
- **Merge policy:** Normal — deliberately agent-initiated only after passing checks and independent signoff. Elevated/Critical — owner approval on this exact reviewed head SHA before merge. No unattended auto-merge.
- Owner approval link + reviewed head SHA (Elevated/Critical only):
- Reassessment required if PR scope or head SHA changes:
